targetStack.architecture: Onion Architecture + Worker Services + Event Driven

globalConstraints: Disaridan erisim yok; sadece ic ag + internal DNS.
DB ve loglarda sifre yok; sadece memory.
MQ mesajlarinda sifre plain olmaz; AES-GCM ile encrypt edilir.
UI ve API ayri deploy edilebilir.
Concurrency kontrollu: PrefetchCount ve UseConcurrencyLimit configten.

definitionOfDone: No secrets or passwords in logs
Deliverables produced and linked in PR description

decisions.auth: OIDC login + group allowlist + DB role mapping
decisions.secretHandling: MQ payload encrypted (AES-GCM) with shared key

packages.title: Infrastructure Prereqs (RabbitMQ + TLS + Accounts)
packages.prompt: Ic agda RabbitMQ kurulumu, TLS sertifika, vhost/permission ve firewall kurallarini dokumante et. Runbook ekle.

expectedOutputs.acceptance: TLS, vhost, user/perm, firewall net tanimli.

done: Roadmap ve configlerde TLS/vhost/use-quorum varsayimlari uygulanmis.
open: Kurumsal runbook ve operasyonel firewall/vhost dokumanlarinin repo disi teyidi.

packages.title: Backend Solution Bootstrap (Onion Architecture)
packages.prompt: Onion Architecture backend solution kur. Katman bagimliliklarini dogru ayarla. Baseline test projesi ekle. README ve docs/architecture-overview.md yaz.

expectedOutputs.acceptance: Solution build olur, en az 1 test calisir.

packages.title: Config & Secrets Strategy
packages.prompt: Ortam bazli config ve secrets yonetimi tanimla. AES-GCM payload encryption ve log redaction politikasini yaz. appsettings.* iskeleti ve Serilog konfig ekle.

expectedOutputs.acceptance: Ortam ayrimi ve logging temel config mevcut.

verificationSteps: Config dosyalarinda secret placeholder var mi?

packages.title: SQL Server Schema + EF Core Models & Migrations
packages.prompt: Domain entity ve enumlari tanimla. Infrastructure DbContext + Fluent API yaz. Migrations uret. docs/data-model.md + mermaid ER ekle.

packages.title: OIDC Login + Group Allowlist + RBAC
packages.prompt: OIDC login akisini uygula. groupClaim icinde allowedGroups yoksa 403. AppUser/Role ile RBAC uygula. docs/auth-rbac.md ekle.

packages.title: TH API Inventory Sync
packages.prompt: TH API client yaz. ServerGroup ve ServerInventory tablolarini guncelle. docs/th-api-inventory.md olustur.

packages.title: AD Password Change Service (LDAPS 636)
packages.prompt: LDAPS ile change password servisi yaz. TLS ve sertifika dogrulama configurable olsun. ErrorCode mapping yap.
done: Retry idempotency notu (old invalid + new bind basarili ise success)

packages.title: Resource Discovery Engine
packages.prompt: Service account kullanimini sunucularda tarayan engine tasarla. Plugin tabanli olsun. Sonuclari JobResource ve JobTargeta yaz.

expectedOutputs.acceptance: Kaynak tipleri ve hata kodlari net.

packages.title: Update Engine (Apply New Password to Resources)
packages.prompt: Her kaynak tipi icin update stratejisi yaz. New password sadece memoryde tutulacak. Idempotent olacak sekilde uygula.

expectedOutputs.acceptance: Update job target bazinda status donuyor.

done: Target account match edilmezse no-op success

packages.title: RabbitMQ Topology + Message Contracts
packages.prompt: MassTransit ile RabbitMQ topology kur. Command/event contractlarini yaz. AES-GCM encrypted payload kullan.

packages.title: Worker Consumers + Concurrency + Retry
packages.prompt: Worker consumerlari yaz. Prefetch ve concurrency limitlerini configten oku. Retry ve timeout uygula.

packages.title: API Endpoints (Auth + Job Create/Status)
packages.prompt: Job create ve izleme endpointlerini uygula. DB kaydi olustur, MQ komutlarini publish et. RBAC ve validation uygula.

packages.title: SignalR Live Updates
packages.prompt: SignalR hub ekle. Worker sonucu eventleri API uzerinden SignalR ile publish et.
done: Worker result event -> API consumer -> SignalR bridge

packages.title: Observability + Audit Trail + Security Checklist
packages.prompt: Structured logging, correlationId ve audit trail standartlarini kur. Redaction zorunlu. docs/audit-and-logging.md + docs/security-checklist.md ekle.

packages.title: UI (Phase 2)
packages.prompt: UI ekranlarini uygula. 2000+ hedef icin paging/virtualization ekle. Role bazli UI guard kur.

packages.title: UserRight Discovery Strategy (Real Implementation)
packages.prompt: UserRight discovery stratejisini stub'dan cikarip gercek implementasyon yap. WinRM/PowerShell ile user right atamalarini topla, JSON output standardina uydur ve JobResource olarak kaydet. docs/discovery-engine.md altina UserRight notlarini ekle.

expectedOutputs.acceptance: UserRight discovery sonucu uretilir ve hata kodlari standard doner.
UserRight discovery yaklasimi ve limitler dokumante.

packages.title: Password-Change Job Orchestration (AD Change + Update + Verify)
packages.prompt: POST /jobs/password-change akisini tek job state machine haline getir: AD (LDAPS) change (old+new) -> update -> verify. Sifreler sadece memoryde kalacak; MQ payload AES-GCM sifreli. Partial failure ve retry davranisini dokumante et.

expectedOutputs.acceptance: AD change basarisizsa update/verify tetiklenmez; status/event akisi stabil.
Orkestrasyon akisi ve riskler (partial failure, replication) net.

done: AD success olmadan update/verify ilerlememe prensibi

packages.title: Resilience Hardening (DLQ + Circuit Breaker/Kill Switch)
packages.prompt: Poison message ve sistematik remote fail durumlari icin hardening ekle: DLQ politikasi, circuit-breaker/kill-switch ve operasyon runbook. docs/reliability-and-error-handling.md guncelle.

expectedOutputs.acceptance: Retry limiti asildiginda mesaj DLQ'ya gider; worker sistematik fail'de kendini frenler.
DLQ/circuit-breaker davranisi ve operasyon adimlari net.

packages.title: Authorization Hardening (DB Allowlist + Job/Hub AuthZ)
packages.prompt: Kurum gereksinimine gore authorization hardening yap: DB'de kayitli ve aktif olmayan kullanici 403 alir. JobId bazli erisim kontrolu ekle. SignalR hub subscribe authz kurallarini tanimla. docs/authz-hardening.md olustur.

expectedOutputs.acceptance: DB allowlist enforced; jobId bazli 403 senaryolari calisir.

packages.title: User & Role Management API (Soft Delete) + Audit Reporting
packages.prompt: Admin/SuperAdmin icin user ve rol yonetimi endpointlerini ekle: user ekle, pasife al, rol ata/kaldir. Physical delete yok. Audit loglarda bu islemleri de kaydet. docs/user-management.md + docs/audit-and-logging.md guncelle.

expectedOutputs.acceptance: User/role yonetimi calisir; audit kaydi olusur; silme yerine pasif edilir.
User lifecycle ve audit alanlari net.

open: Paket kapanis kriterlerinin test/dokuman/runbook seviyesinde net finalizasyonu

packages.title: Permission Model (Fine-Grained Authorization)
packages.prompt: Role disinda ince yetkiler icin permission modeli ekle (Permission + RolePermission). Policy-based authorization ile endpoint/hub yetkilerini tanimla. docs/permissions-model.md olustur.

expectedOutputs.acceptance: Permission tabanli yetkilendirme calisir ve migration ile DB kurulabilir.
Permission modeli ve policy haritasi dokumante.

packages.title: Observability v2 (OpenTelemetry + HealthChecks + Rate Limiting)
packages.prompt: Kurumsal operasyon icin observability genislet: OpenTelemetry trace/metric, healthcheck endpointleri, API rate limiting ve daha guclu security headers. docs/observability.md olustur.

expectedOutputs.acceptance: Healthcheck + OTel export + rate limiting calisir.

packages.title: SignalR Scale-Out (Backplane) + Deployment Guide
packages.prompt: API scale-out senaryosu icin SignalR backplane (Redis) opsiyonunu ekle ve deploy guide yaz. Sticky session vs backplane kararlarini dokumante et.

packages.title: Key Rotation + Secret Management Runbooks
packages.prompt: AES-GCM key rotation (KeyId) ve secret/certificate rotation icin runbook ve (gerekirse) multi-key decrypt destegi ekle. docs/ops-runbooks.md olustur.

expectedOutputs.acceptance: KeyId ile decrypt edilebilir; rotation senaryosu desteklenir veya dokumante edilir.
Key/cert/secret rotation adimlari ve guvenlik notlari net.

currentPrimaryPhase.name: User & Role Management API + Soft Delete + Audit
currentPrimaryPhase.reason: Admin user/role API ve bootstrap mevcut, fakat paket kapanis kriterleri dokumantasyonda halen 'tamamlama' asamasinda takip ediliyor.

notes: PKG-000 altyapi onkosulu oldugu icin repo disi/isletimsel kabul edilmis durumda.
